questions.query: 在 ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation set 上，关闭 definer 的 think scratchpad 与关闭 train-feedback refinement 两项消融，对 pass@2 的影响分别是多少？

candidate_evidence_groups.quote: disabling the definer’s think scratchpad costs −5.75 pp pass@2, while disabling train-feedback refinement only yields −0.75 pp.

candidate_answer_points: think scratchpad removal: −5.75 percentage points pass@2
train-feedback refinement removal: −0.75 percentage points pass@2
forbidden_inferences: Do not describe percentage-point changes as relative percentages.
Do not infer that the smaller ablation has no effect.

questions.query: 论文报告的 CoT→Pipeline（pass@2）与 Pipeline→Reflective Orchestrator（pass@2）配对 bootstrap 增幅及其 95% CI 分别是多少？

candidate_evidence_groups.quote: Pipeline→Reflective Orchestrator (pass@2)+9.75 ∗ [+6.50,+13.25]

candidate_answer_points: Pipeline→Reflective Orchestrator: +9.75 pp, 95% CI [+6.50,+13.25]
The asterisk indicates the CI excludes zero.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat the two transitions as measurements on different task samples; the reported comparison is paired.

questions.query: Tongyi DeepResearch 的 Agentic CPT mid-training 怎样安排两个阶段的上下文长度和长序列数据？

candidate_evidence_groups.quote: We initiate with a 32K context length in the first stage, before expanding to 128K in the second.
a substantial corpus of long-sequence (64K-128K) agentic behavior data.

candidate_answer_points: Agentic CPT 分两阶段
第一阶段 32K，第二阶段 128K
第二阶段引入 64K–128K 的长序列 Agent 行为数据
forbidden_inferences: Do not present the context length as the model's maximum inference context in every later experiment.

questions.query: Tongyi DeepResearch 把 Agent 训练环境分成哪三类？分别概括各类在稳定性、成本或真实反馈上的取舍。

candidate_evidence_groups.quote: perfect stability, zero interaction cost, and unlimited scalability, but lacks real-world feedback signals.
stability, rapid response, and low cost
a notable sim-to-real gap.
the most authentic data distribution and feedback signals
continuous distribution shift in training data
The tangible expense of each API call makes large-scale exploration economically prohibitive.

candidate_answer_points: Prior World: stable, zero interaction cost, scalable, but no real-world feedback
Simulated: controlled and reproducible with low cost and fast response, but sim-to-real gap
Real-world: the most authentic distribution and feedback; the report separately identifies non-stationarity and per-call expense as real-world interaction challenges
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim the simulated environment fully matches real-world data.
Do not present the report's general non-stationarity and API-cost observations as measured environment-specific values.
